description_en: Perform a paged query to retrieve the list of Intelligent Contact Robot call jobs. The response includes the total number of jobs and job details
description_zh: 分页查询智能联络机器人呼叫任务列表。包含任务总数、任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs list-task --task-name '任务测试' --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --status STOP --task-id 120000 --robot-name '机器人' --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTask

parameters.help_en: The job name. You can view the names of created jobs in the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) interface
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)界面查看已创建的任务名称
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The current page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于0，默认值：1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of items per page. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量。取值大于0，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Job Status. Valid values:

INIT: Not started.
RELEASE: Parsing.
RUNNING: Executing.
STOP: Paused manually.
SYSTEM_STOP: Paused by the system.
READY: Pending execution.
CANCEL: Stopped manually.
SYSTEM_CANCEL: Stopped by the system.
DONE: Completed
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：

INIT：未开始。
RELEASE：解析中。
RUNNING：执行中。
STOP：手动暂停。
SYSTEM_STOP：系统暂停。
READY：待执行。
CANCEL：手动终止。
SYSTEM_CANCEL：系统终止。
DONE：已完成
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The unique job ID of the robot calling job. You can view it in the Task Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) interface or obtain it by using the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html API
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。在任务管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)界面查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html接口获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The robot name, which is the script name. You can view the names of scripts that have passed Review in the Script Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list) interface
parameters.help_zh: 机器人名称。即为话术名称，在话术管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list)界面查看已经通过审核的话术名称
parameters.name: robot_name
